news.title: New major risk - Dividend sustainability
news.body: The dividend is not well covered by earnings and cash flows. Payout ratio: 0% The company is paying a dividend despite having no free cash flows. Dividend yield: 2.2% This is considered a major risk. Companies that pay out too much of their earnings and cash flows are at risk of having to reduce or cut their dividend in future. If earnings or cash flows stagnate or fall, then there may not be enough to maintain the same dividend. Or in extreme cases, companies may opt to dig into capital reserves or take on debt to maintain the dividend. For dividend paying companies, any reduction in the dividend can significantly impact the share price. news.title: EKI Energy Services Limited (BSE:543284) agreed to acquire remaining 14.11% stake in GHG Reduction Technologies Private Limited from EKI Services Limited and Manish Kumar Dabkara for INR 6.1 million.
news.body:
EKI Energy Services Limited (BSE:543284) agreed to acquire remaining 14.11% stake in GHG Reduction Technologies Private Limited from EKI Services Limited and Manish Kumar Dabkara for INR 6.1 million on January 22, 2026. Upon completion, EKI Energy Services Limited will own 100% stake in GHG Reduction Technologies Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, GHG Reduction Technologies Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 101.42 million. As of March 31, 2025, GHG Reduction Technologies Private Limited reported total common equity of INR 126.08 million.

The transaction has been approved by the Board of Directors of EKI Energy Services Limited. The expected completion of the transaction is March 31, 2026.
